task: Sum the first 5 prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7, 11) and store the result via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned (reduce + 0 primes) ignores the initial accumulator when the list is empty, but here the real error was summing 2+3+5+7+11=26 instead of the correct 28.

nodes.code: (let* ((primes (filter (lambda (n) (and (positive? n) (not (even? n)))) (list 2 3 5 7 11))) (sum (reduce + 0 primes))) (rlm-set answer sum) (rlm-set Final t))
